cert_name: Registration and Annual Practising Certificate (APC), Registered Nurse
issuer: Nursing Board Malaysia (Lembaga Jururawat Malaysia), MOH
entry_requirement: Pass the Malaysian Nursing Board Examination or the BPL final examination of a college recognised by the Board
how_to_get: Register with the Nursing Board Malaysia, then hold an APC to practise in health facilities
notes: Nurses Act 1950 and Nurses Registration Regulations 1985; fees not stated on the page

cert_name: Registration and Annual Practising Certificate (APC), allied health practitioner
issuer: Malaysian Allied Health Professions Council (MAHPC), MOH
entry_requirement: Qualification in a profession listed in the Second Schedule of the Allied Health Professions Act 2016 (Act 774)
how_to_get: Apply on the MHPS portal (mhps.moh.gov.my); registration deadline under the transition period is 2026-12-31
source_name: Bernama - MAHPC extends registration transition period
notes: Practising without registration and a valid APC after 2026-12-31 is an offence; article does not name physiotherapy, check the Act 774 Second Schedule
